access_boundary: This record represents the Grok 4.6 release served under the xAI API model name grok-4.6, with no dated snapshot ID published. xAI's own API, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry, the fast variant, Grok consumer apps, Grok Build, gateway partners, and later Grok releases remain separate service or product boundaries.
